name: m3-04-zakat-tax-credit
title: Zakat paid in Aceh should reduce income tax owed; after twenty years it only reduces taxable income.
sourceLine: Source: UU 11/2006 Art 192; Baitul Mal Aceh Utara, 29 Sep 2024; Pikiran Rakyat Aceh; MK, 13 Nov 2025; RRI (PMK 114/2025); Kompas, 26 May 2026. [1142][1111][1112][1114][1113][1122]
